اعصوصبا (form XII)
# اِعْصَوْصَبَا (iʕṣawṣabā) /iʕ.sˤaw.sˤa.baː/: third-person masculine dual past active of اِعْصَوْصَبَ (iʕṣawṣaba)
# اِعْصَوْصِبَا (iʕṣawṣibā) /iʕ.sˤaw.sˤi.baː/: second-person dual imperative of اِعْصَوْصَبَ (iʕṣawṣaba)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
